entries.name: Stripe

zh-CN.name: Stripe
zh-CN.description: 通过 Stripe 官方托管的 MCP 服务查询和管理 Stripe 的客户、产品、价格、发票、支付链接、订阅、退款与争议，并搜索 Stripe 文档。用 Stripe 账号登录。有写权限时，它能创建和作废发票、修改和取消订阅、退款，在开通了的账户里还能转出资金：除非确有需要，请在 Stripe 授权页上只授予沙盒，或只给正式环境只读权限。
examples: 列出我最近 10 笔 Stripe 付款，标出失败或被争议的。
在我的 Stripe 沙盒里创建产品“Pro 套餐”，每月 20 美元，并给我一个支付链接。
搜索 Stripe 文档，看看怎么用 Webhook 处理订阅扣款失败。

entries.description: Look up and manage customers, products, prices, invoices, payment links, subscriptions, refunds and disputes in Stripe, and search Stripe's docs, through Stripe's hosted MCP server. Sign in with your Stripe account. With write access it can create and void invoices, change and cancel subscriptions, issue refunds and, where enabled, send money: on Stripe's consent page grant a sandbox, or read-only access to live mode, unless you mean it.

note.zh-CN: 由 Wevir 维护的连接设置，连接 Stripe 官方托管的 MCP 服务
note.en: Connection settings maintained by Wevir for Stripe's own hosted MCP server

examples: List my 10 most recent Stripe payments and flag any that failed or were disputed.
In my Stripe sandbox, create a product "Pro plan" at $20 a month and give me a payment link for it.
Search the Stripe docs for how to handle failed subscription payments with webhooks.

entries.name: Supabase

zh-CN.name: Supabase
zh-CN.description: 通过 Supabase 官方托管的 MCP 服务以只读方式查看你的 Supabase 项目：列出数据表与迁移、执行只读 SQL、查看日志以及安全与性能建议、生成 TypeScript 类型、搜索 Supabase 文档。用 Supabase 账号登录。
examples: 列出我 Supabase 项目里的数据表和各自的行数，说明它们之间的关系。
对我的项目运行 Supabase 的安全与性能检查，告诉我先修哪一项。
为我的 Supabase 数据库结构生成 TypeScript 类型。

entries.description: Explore your Supabase projects read-only through Supabase's hosted MCP server: list tables and migrations, run read-only SQL, read logs and security and performance advisors, generate TypeScript types, and search Supabase's docs. Sign in with your Supabase account.

note.zh-CN: 由 Wevir 维护的连接设置，连接 Supabase 官方托管的 MCP 服务
note.en: Connection settings maintained by Wevir for Supabase's own hosted MCP server

examples: List the tables in my Supabase project with their row counts, and describe how they relate.
Run the Supabase security and performance advisors on my project and explain what to fix first.
Generate TypeScript types for my Supabase database schema.
